门店清单怎样做 · How to do the store checklists

24 Xpress App · 员工、店长和 HQ · Staff, managers and HQ · App 2026-11-21.324

先看这里 · Read first

三条规矩Three rules

  1. 做完一项，就勾一项。不要等最后一次全部勾。一分钟内勾完全部的清单，不算证明。
    Finish an item, then tick it. Do not tick everything at the end. A list ticked all inside one minute is not proven.
  2. 在规定时间内做。太早或太晚勾，都不算证明。时间看下面的表。
    Do it in its time. Ticks too early or too late are not proven. See the times in the table below.
  3. 先打卡，再做清单。勾的人当时要在这家店打了卡。要拍照的项目，一定要拍真的照片。
    Clock in first, then do the list. The person ticking must be clocked in at this store. Items that need a photo need a real photo.
服务器每天检查每一张做完的清单。HQ 看得到每间店有几张「已证明」、几张「未证明」和原因。
The server checks every finished list every day. HQ sees, for each store, how many are proven, how many are not, and why.

过了「几点前做完」还有 1 小时可以补，之后再勾就算「时间不对」。凌晨 4 点前的清单算前一天。截止前 30 分钟还没人开始，正在店里打卡的同事会收到提醒。
After "Finish by" there is 1 more hour to catch up; ticks after that count as "wrong time". Lists before 4 am belong to the day before. If nobody has started 30 minutes before the finish time, colleagues clocked in at the store get a reminder.
① 员工 · Staff

打开今天的清单Open today's lists

按底部的 任务。你的店今天要做的清单都在这里。只会看到今天要做的；不用做的日子不会出现（例如咖啡馆星期日）。
Tap Tasks at the bottom. Your store's lists for today are here. You only see today's lists; lists not due that day do not show (e.g. café lists on Sunday).

  1. 已证明：做完了，而且算数。没证明的会写橙色原因，例如「一分钟内全部勾完」。
    Proven: done and it counts. A list that is not proven shows the reason in orange, e.g. "All ticked inside 1 minute".
  2. 蓝色 现在做：现在就是这张清单的时间。清单按一天的先后排好。
    Blue Do now: it is this list's time now. Lists are in the order of the day.
  3. ⏰ 后面是这张清单的时间（开始–做完）。过了时间会变红。点清单就开始。
    After ⏰ is the list's time (start – finish by). It turns red when late. Tap a list to start.
任务 · Tasks
② 员工 · Staff

做一项，勾一项Do an item, tick it

  1. 做完这一项，按左边的方格打勾。App 会记下谁勾、几点勾。
    When an item is done, tap the box on the left. The App records who ticked it and when.
  2. 写着「拍照」的项目：按 拍照，拍真的照片，拍好就自动打勾。
    Items marked "photo": tap Take Photo and take a real photo; it ticks itself when the photo is in.
  3. 全部勾好，按 完成清单。还有没勾的项目时，这个按钮是灰的。
    When all are ticked, tap Complete checklist. It stays grey while items are open.
太早或太晚打勾，App 会先问：「现在勾，不算证明。还是要勾吗？」最上面也写着这张清单的时间。
Tick too early or too late and the App asks first: "A tick now is not proof. Tick anyway?" The list's time is shown at the top.
没网络时，不用拍照的项目会先存在手机里（显示 📤），有网络再自动送出。拍照的项目一定要有网络。
With no signal, items without a photo wait on the phone (📤) and send by themselves later. Photo items need signal.
打勾 · Tick
③ 员工 · Staff

已证明，还是未证明Proven or not proven

做完的清单打开来，最上面写着结果。
Open a finished list: the result is at the top.

  1. 已证明：一项一项慢慢做、时间对、照片齐。
    Proven: items done one by one, in time, photos in.
已证明 · Proven
  1. 未证明 和原因。这张 4 项在 31 秒内全部勾完，所以不算。
    Not proven and why. This list had all 4 items ticked in 31 seconds, so it does not count.
原因有：一分钟内全部勾完 · 不在规定时间内勾 · 勾的人当时没在这家店打卡 · 缺照片 · 当天没有温度记录。
The reasons: all ticked inside 1 minute · ticked outside its time · ticked by someone not clocked in at this store · photo missing · no temperature reading that day.
未证明 · Not proven

各店清单证明（最近 7 天）Checklist proof by store (last 7 days)

HQ 在 任务 → 全部分店，往下看 清单证明。
HQ: Tasks → All Branches, scroll to Checklist proof.

  1. 最近 7 天做完几张、几张已证明。
    Lists done in the last 7 days, and how many are proven.
  2. 红字「有清单，但一张都没做完」的店排在最上面。
    Stores in red "Has lists, but none finished" are on top.
  3. 每店一行：清单数、已证明、和每种原因几张。点店号看每一张。
    One row per store: lists, proven, and how many for each reason. Tap a store to see each list.
清单证明 · Proof
  1. 点一间店：每张清单一行，写着日期、清单名、几项、第一勾到最后一勾几秒、原因。例：5 项 9 秒勾完 = 没有真的做。
    Tap a store: one row per list with the day, list name, items, seconds from first to last tick, and reasons. E.g. 5 items in 9 seconds = not really done.
一间店 · One store
⑤ HQ

改清单的时间和星期Change a list's times and weekdays

我的 → 任务清单模板，点一张清单。
Me → Checklist templates, tap a list.

  1. 最早开始时间：比这个时间早勾的，不算证明。
    Earliest start time: ticks before this are not proven.
  2. 几点前做完：过了就显示「逾时」，再过 1 小时勾就算时间不对。
    Finish by: after it the list shows "Late"; ticks 1 hour after it count as wrong time.
  3. 星期几要做：1 = 星期一 … 7 = 星期日。写 1-5 = 星期一到五。空着 = 每天。不用做的日子，员工看不到这张清单，不会收到提醒，分数也不扣。
    Weekdays: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. 1-5 = Monday to Friday. Empty = every day. On days off, staff do not see the list, get no reminder, and the store score is not marked down.
改了清单项目，已经开始的清单不会变；员工下一次打开会拿到新的。
Changing the items does not change a list already started; staff get the new one next time.
